# Salow Technologies (Salowtech)

> Sovereign software engineering studio specializing in custom enterprise ERP, CRM, HRM, mobile applications, web platforms, and autonomous AI voice assistants.

## What Salowtech Does
Salowtech engineers sovereign, production-grade business software platforms built with modern cloud architectures, PostgreSQL, React, Node.js, and Flutter. Clients receive 100% intellectual property ownership, zero per-seat SaaS taxes, and full data sovereignty.

## Core Services
- **Custom CRM Development:** Omnichannel lead capture, automated pipeline management, WhatsApp Cloud API integration, and telephony sync.
- **Enterprise ERP Development:** Real-time multi-plant telemetry, supply chain synchronization, inventory management, and automated GST compliance.
- **HRM & Payroll Software:** Biometric clock-in, GPS geofencing, employee self-service (ESS) portals, and 1-click statutory tax & payroll processing.
- **AI Voice Assistants:** 24/7 autonomous conversational telephony agents, multi-language speech models, and CRM inquiry resolution with sub-second latency.
- **Web App Development:** High-performance, scalable web portals, SaaS platforms, and enterprise dashboards built with modern frontend frameworks.
- **Mobile App Development:** Native iOS, Android, and cross-platform Flutter applications engineered for 120 FPS performance and offline-first capabilities.
- **SEO, AEO & GEO Services:** Technical search optimization, Core Web Vitals engineering, and Answer Engine / Generative Engine Optimization for AI platforms.
